title: Synthesizer Project - DP-CTGAN & Differential Privacy Research
summary: A research project studying differentially private synthetic tabular data generation, evaluating privacy, utility, fidelity and diversity trade-offs across epsilon values on census and word-embedding datasets. It fits and evaluates SDV's TVAESynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer models (with Metadata detection and FixedCombinations constraints) as the core generators under study, running SDV's sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata APIs directly.
